text: Emiko Ono, Manager, Program Policy and Meredith Kratzmann, Senior Strategic Policy Consultant, Program Policy, from the Housing Secretariat will provide a brief update on the City’s plans to procure and implement a ‘Housing as a Human Right’ training program for staff in housing-related City divisions, agencies, and corporations.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Deferred consideration of Item HS7.10 until the November 19, 2025 meeting of the Housing Rights Advisory Committee.
